description: Haziran wears a long ivory lightweight tunic and a brown open-front robe with wide geometric gold and dark-brown embroidery around the front edges, cuffs and lower hem. A patterned dark woven sash wraps the waist and hangs in a fringed end. The tunic has an embroidered split neckline and fitted pale cuffs. Brown leather ankle shoes show below both robe hems. The silhouette is opaque, flowing and relaxed with hands visible at his sides. No headgear, armor, weapon or modern accessory appears.
